== Description ==
'''Praisin''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that is bundled with the Meme Emotes gamepass which can be bought for {{Robux|55}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/113381854/profile Falosaur]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

==Trivia==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] is based on the popular internet meme [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ETbOX50t0kw Y'all mind if I praise the lord?].
**The store description is a sentence said in the video.
**The original music is a remixed version of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jr41skFqzb8 Kirk Franklin - Revolution], the song that plays in the video.
*During [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], this emote could be bought for coins instead of Robux for testing.
*During the [[Metaverse Champions Event]], this emote was used as the walking animation for [[Fey Yoshida]].
